current_composition.notes: 119th Congress: 53 R, 45 D, 2 independents (King ME, Sanders VT) caucusing with Dems. Dems need net +4 for 51 (VP Vance breaks 50-50 ties). 35 seats up: 33 Class 2 + FL and OH specials; 22 R-held, 13 D-held. Three R-held seats have appointed incumbents (FL Moody, OH Husted, SC D. Graham) and OK's appointee Armstrong is not running.

rating_scale_notes: Cook: Solid/Likely/Lean/Toss-up. Inside Elections: Solid/Likely/Lean/Tilt/Toss-up. Sabato: Safe/Likely/Leans/Toss-up. Silver/Economist/Split Ticket ratings taken from Wikipedia state pages (as of Oct 27-28).
poll_avg_notes: For competitive races poll_avg is the Wikipedia composite (mean of 270toWin, DDHQ, FiftyPlusOne, RCP and Silver Bulletin averages) with sub-fields for RCP and PollCheck; n_polls is PollCheck's poll count. For safe races PollCheck's average or swing estimate is used. RCP's main site blocks fetches; Texas uses RCP directly. margin is dem minus rep (or ind minus rep where noted).
